about_the_game: The demo for Fittest Fire contains 4 areas, 10 enemy types, and 3 bosses. It also allows you to test out the concept of working out to level up. The demo includes a link to the Fittest Fire mobile app where you can start logging exercises to earn points. The demo will allow you to use these points to level up.
detailed_description: The demo for Fittest Fire contains 4 areas, 10 enemy types, and 3 bosses. It also allows you to test out the concept of working out to level up. The demo includes a link to the Fittest Fire mobile app where you can start logging exercises to earn points. The demo will allow you to use these points to level up.
ext_user_account_notice: Players will need to create a Fittest Fire account in order to level up in the game. Players will create their accounts during the Fittest Fire mobile app onboarding process. The game includes links to the Google Play store so players can easily find the Fittest Fire mobile app.
